episodes.193492: Severe thunderstorms were reported in the southern half of the Nebraska Panhandle the afternoon and evening of 21 August.

episodes.194251: An active week of severe weather unfolded across the Northern Rockies from August 18th through the 21st. Subtle waves lifting through a southwesterly flow aloft just west of an upper level ridge combined with ample surface heating and shear to result in multiple rounds of severe weather, most notably on August 19th when a line of strong thunderstorms lifted northward across the plains and adjacent areas.
episodes.194734: A thunderstorm produced gusty winds at Patrick Space Force Base.
episodes.194735: A thunderstorm produced a waterspout on Lake Jesup. It did not move onshore.
episodes.194811: A strong thunderstorm developed over northern Jackson County, producing hail up to nickel size west of Kadoka.
episodes.194813: A line of severe thunderstorms developed over far southwest South Dakota, producing wind gusts to over 60 mph across portions of Fall River and Oglala Lakota counties.
episodes.195429: Another influx of monsoon moisture fueled scattered thunderstorms over southeast California. Some storms produced high winds and flash flooding.
episodes.195767: Modest instability and downdraft CAPE near a sea breeze circulation led to thunderstorms developing and then capable of producing damaging wind gusts as a cold front pushed south along the coast.
episodes.195859: A stalled frontal boundary across northern Florida, with steady southwesterly flow, allowed moisture to pool and favored afternoon shower and thunderstorm chances. This allowed for occasional strong to severe thunderstorms with potential for heavy downpours and gusty winds on August 21st.
episodes.195895: An area of severe thunderstorms including a confirmed tornado occurred in Cochise County. Severe wind gusts, hail and flash flooding also occurred with these storms.
episodes.196021: A line of thunderstorms tracked into far southwestern Nebraska during the late evening hours of August 21nst This line produced a 58 MPH wind gust at the Grant Municipal Airport. Activity weakened as it migrated east.
episodes.196079: An active upper level pattern with a series of shortwave troughs moving over the region throughout the course of the week produced several days of strong to severe thunderstorms over the region.
episodes.196118: After a dry period,  deep mosoon moisture returned to northern Arizona with shower and thunderstorm ramping up.
episodes.196343: Evening thunderstorms south of a stalled out frontal boundary over the north-central Florida peninsula produce a waterspout offshore Holiday located in Pasco County.
episodes.196344: Morning thunderstorms south of a stalled out frontal boundary over the north-central Florida peninsula produce a waterspout over eastern Charlotte Harbor south of Charlotte Park.
